content: The dashboard takes forever to load on my laptop. Every time I switch boards there is a spinner for 5+ seconds.
Hard to figure out how to invite my whole team. The getting-started guide did not mention team invites at all.
Please add dark mode! I work late and the white screens are painful on the eyes.
Upgraded to Pro but the invoice still shows the old amount. The line items are really confusing.
App is unusable in the afternoon. Reports time out constantly and I lose my work.
We need a Gantt chart view. The timeline view is nice but not enough for our project managers.
Took a full day to set up our project templates. There should be preset templates to start from.
Cancelled the trial but I was still charged. Support has not replied to my email yet.
Dark mode would be a huge win for us - half our dev team asked for it this week.
The Zapier integration keeps failing silently. We get no notification when the sync breaks.
Wish there were per-user workload limits. Right now we cannot see who is over capacity.
Mobile web app is slow and janky. It crashed twice while I was adding tasks on my phone.
Pricing is only in USD? We pay in BRL and the tax calculation is wrong on our invoice.
A native mobile app with offline mode would be amazing for our field teams.
Dark mode please. Our whole team switched to dark OS themes and this app is blinding us.
The invite emails land in spam. New teammates cannot find the workspace they were added to.
Search across all projects is extremely slow once you pass about 5k tasks.
Would love a way to duplicate tasks together with their subtasks and due dates.
